welcome.title: Start-up sequence
welcome.body: Welcome to the yard. This tutorial walks you through the first real loop: generate scrap, run the crusher, sell metal, and buy your first upgrade.

generate_scrap.title: Generate scrap
generate_scrap.body: Begin by unloading scrap manually. The highlighted button spends money and fills the crusher's input stock.

activate_crusher.title: Activate the crusher
activate_crusher.body: Now switch the crusher on. If it has scrap available, it will start cycling and turn raw material into metal.

watch_crusher_progress.title: Watch the cycle
watch_crusher_progress.body: Keep an eye on the progress bar. Once the cycle completes, the line will have produced its first unit of metal.

collect_metal.title: Metal online
collect_metal.body: Your metal stock now shows in the top header. That row tells you what is coming in and what is ready to sell or process further.

sell_metal.title: Make some cash
sell_metal.body: Sell one unit of metal to recover money. Early on, this manual sale keeps your loop alive while you unlock more lines.

buy_first_upgrade.title: Buy an upgrade
buy_first_upgrade.body: Push progression forward by buying the crusher's first upgrade. The right panel is your main investment and scaling hub.

check_next_goal.title: Read the next goal
check_next_goal.body: Look at the progression hint on top. It summarizes the requirements for the next unlock and shows your current bottleneck.

complete.title: Shift complete
complete.body: You have finished the yard's core loop. From here the goal is to scale production, open new machines, and keep throughput stable.
